title: Coherent compact-support comparison on coefficient systems
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], with algebraic closure $k$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. Let $E\subset F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R=\mathcal O_E\subset S=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting]. For $T=X,Y$, put $A_{n,T}=(R/\ell^n)_T$, $B_{n,T}=(S/\ell^n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site, and use the ordinary derived categories of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal N_A(T),\mathcal N_B(T)$ for their normalized constructible subcategories with uniform cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and $C_T=-\otimes^L_{A_{\bullet,T}}B_{\bullet,T}$ for scalar extension of whole systems [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Twists mean [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write $P_A=Rf_{!,A,\bullet}\dashv G_A=f^!_{A,\bullet}$ and $P_B\dashv G_B$ for the specified tower adjunctions, with units $\eta_A,\eta_B$ and counits $\epsilon_A,\epsilon_B$ [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Fix the same compactification for the two compact-support functors [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. There is a specified natural isomorphism of functors $\mathcal N_A(X)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(Y,S))$,
$$b:C_YP_A\xrightarrow{\sim}P_BC_X.$$
It is the actual coefficient-system morphism formed from the proper direct-image coefficient mate and the open-extension tensor identification on the simultaneous models [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], and evaluates at every $n$ to the specified finite map $b_{R/\ell^n,S/\ell^n}$ of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image]. For $n\ge m$, both scalar paths $R/\ell^n\to S/\ell^n\to S/\ell^m$ and $R/\ell^n\to R/\ell^m\to S/\ell^m$ give the same transition comparison; after tensor reassociation it is the map associated to $R/\ell^n\to S/\ell^m$. This assertion concerns the map in the ordinary derived category of whole systems, not only the family of its evaluations. For $E\subset F\subset L$ the composite of the two such $b$ transformations equals the transformation for $E\subset L$, under balanced scalar associators, as an equality of system morphisms before evaluation or inverse limit. Identity extensions give identities.

proof.text: Apply field_shriek_system_realization to obtain D and its finite evaluation law e for the fixed compactification. This performs old steps 1--3 without any assertion of invertibility or cocycles.

For normalized M, use its constructible finite-Tor level predicate in the original strict-tower coordinates. The section-preserving derived realization counit and levelComparison identify that level with Ev_n M. Its cohomology is supported in a finite integer interval. Each ell-power quotient is killed by ell^(n+1), by Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and Ideal.pow_mem_pow. The fixed base field has characteristic p. Apply reductionDirectImage_isIso at every level and transport its invertibility along the level-coordinate isomorphism. In EvaluationLaw.evaluation the other scalar and support factors are all isomorphisms, so cancellation proves that Ev_n(comparison.app M) is invertible. Apply (D.base F).calculus Y .detects to obtain invertibility of the already constructed whole-system comparison.

Apply field_shriek_system_mixed with the same D and e to obtain the mixed quotient law, and field_shriek_system_cocycle to obtain whole-system composition and identity. Assemble these two records with the invertibility record into Laws P D c, and introduce the existential witness D. The original target statement and every clause of Laws remain unchanged.
